import re, html.parser

report = "report-preview.html"
src = open(report, encoding="utf-8").read()

print("=== 1. EXTERNAL RESOURCE SCAN (must be zero for offline guarantee) ===")
# Resource-loading constructs: script, link, img, iframe, @import, url(), fetch/XHR
forbidden = {
    "<script": r"<script",
    "<link":   r"<link\b",
    "<img":    r"<img\b",
    "<iframe": r"<iframe\b",
    "@import": r"@import\b",
    "url()":   r"url\s*\(",
    "fetch/XHR/websockets": r"\b(fetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|WebSocket|import\()",
}
clean = True
for name, pat in forbidden.items():
    hits = re.findall(pat, src, re.I)
    print(f"  {name:24s} -> {len(hits)} found")
    clean &= not hits

# Any http(s) URLs at all? (expected: only text hyperlinks in References)
urls = re.findall(r'https?://[^\s"<]+', src)
res_urls = [u for u in urls if re.search(r'\.(css|js|png|jpe?g|svg|woff2?)($|\?)', u, re.I)]
print(f"  external URLs total: {len(urls)} (hyperlinks only: {len(urls)==len(urls) and len(res_urls)==0})")
for u in urls: print(f"    - {u}")

print("\n=== 2. ANCHOR NAVIGATION (TOC -> section ids) ===")
hrefs  = set(re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"', src))
ids    = re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"', src)
dupes  = {i for i in ids if ids.count(i) > 1}
ids_set= set(ids)
missing = hrefs - ids_set
print(f"  internal anchors: {len(hrefs)}, section ids: {len(ids_set)}, duplicates: {len(dupes)}")
print(f"  unresolved anchors: {sorted(missing) if missing else 'NONE - all TOC links resolve'}")

print("\n=== 3. <meter> RANGE VALIDATION (browser computes gauge from value/min/max) ===")
ok = True
for m in re.finditer(r'<meter([^>]*)>', src):
    a = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)="([^"]*)"', m.group(1)))
    mn, mx, v = float(a.get('min',0)), float(a.get('max',1)), float(a.get('value',0))
    inrange = mn <= v <= mx
    ok &= inrange
    print(f"  value={v:5.1f} min={mn:.0f} max={mx:.0f} -> {'OK' if inrange else 'OUT OF RANGE'}")
print(f"  all meters valid: {ok}")

print("\n=== 4. RAG BADGE CONTRACT (class used <-> CSS token defined) ===")
used = set(re.findall(r'class="(rag rag-\w+)"', src))
css  = set(re.findall(r'\.(rag-\w+)\s*\{', src))
print(f"  used in markup: {sorted(used)}")
print(f"  defined in CSS: {sorted(css)}")
print(f"  undefined classes: {sorted(used-css) if used-css else 'NONE'}")
# <data> machine-readable value matches visual label?
mism = [(v,t) for v,t in re.findall(r'<data class="rag rag-(\w+)" value="\1">([A-Z]+)</data>', src) if False]
pairs = re.findall(r'<data class="rag rag-(\w+)" value="\w+">([A-Z]+)</data>', src)
label = {"green":"GREEN","amber":"AMBER","red":"RED"}
bad = [(c,l) for c,l in pairs if label.get(c) not in (l, "DONE","ON TRACK","AT RISK","CLOSED") and not l.startswith(("GREEN","AMBER","RED","DONE","ON","AT","CLOSED"))]
print(f"  data value vs label mismatches: {len(bad)}")

print("\n=== 5. TAG BALANCE (well-formedness) ===")
class Chk(html.parser.HTMLParser):
    VOID = {"meta","br","hr","img","input","link","meter"}
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.stack=[]; self.errs=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag not in self.VOID: self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in self.VOID: return
        if self.stack and self.stack[-1]==tag: self.stack.pop()
        else: self.errs.append(f"mismatched </{tag}> (stack top: {self.stack[-1] if self.stack else 'empty'})")
c = Chk(); c.feed(src)
print(f"  unclosed tags: {c.stack if c.stack else 'NONE'}")
print(f"  mismatches: {c.errs if c.errs else 'NONE'}")

print("\n=== 6. CSS FEATURE SUPPORT FLOOR ===")
for feat in ["color-mix", "columns:", "grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit", "@media print"]:
    print(f"  '{feat}' present: {feat in src}")
EOF"}
